title: Residual profiles and bounded generation in pro-$p$ completions of amalgamated products
summary: This paper completely classifies when the pro-$p$ completion of an amalgamated product has bounded generation, assuming its starting vertex groups are already boundedly generated. We first prove that the pro-$p$ completion of any abstract amalgam always naturally forms a proper pro-$p$ amalgam. Within this framework, we show that bounded generation is extremely rare.
